cclquery_xml_specification.query_list_structure: <query_list xCount="N"><query_list_item1 domain="<DomainUUID>" inline_ind="0|1" name="<QueryName>" uuid="<QueryUUID>" version="2">
cclquery_xml_specification.cross_domain_inline_subquery_mechanics: When a DA2 query joins two domains (e.g., CWC Encounter + CWF GS Revenue or CWF GS Payments), DA2 creates <query_list xCount="2"> where <query_list_item2 inline_ind="1" name="Revenue"> is compiled into an inline SQL view (...) "Revenue" and joined to the primary domain via <filter joinType="3" mode="1" useIndex="1"> -> Oracle (+) outer join CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID = "Revenue"."Revenue:Enc Id"(+).
cclquery_xml_specification.multi_query_union_mechanics: When two <query_list_item> entries both have inline_ind="0" and identical column arity, Discern SQL Engine (EJS) compiles them into a SQL UNION query.
cclquery_xml_specification.qualification_filter_list_xml: Every Filter List qualification in <cclquery> XML serializes both the human-readable DISPLAY string and the numeric CODE_VALUE via <values type="LIST" xCount="N"><value display="<DISPLAY>" text="<CODE_VALUE>"/></values>.

rptdesign_xml_specification.before_open_guardrail: Always wrap reportContext.getGlobalVariable("location") inside if (typeof reportContext !== "undefined" && reportContext !== null) so DA2's save-time Rhino validator (__bm_beforeOpen) succeeds.

  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Facility,
  omf_get_cv_display(CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD) AS Enc_Loc_Nurse_Unit,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.REG_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Admit_Dt_Tm,
  cclsql_utc_cnvt(CWC_ENCOUNTER.DISCH_DT_TM, 1, 54) AS Enc_Discharge_Dt_Tm,
  CWC_ENC_FUNC.GET_FIN_NBR(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID) AS Enc_FIN,
  CWC_PER_FUNC.GET_MRN(CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID, CWC_ENCOUNTER.LOC_FACILITY_CD) AS Person_MRN_Facility,
  CWC_PERSON.NAME_FULL_FORMATTED AS Person_Name_Full,

  CWF_RC_F_REVENUE.SERVICE_DT_TM AS Rev_Service_Dt,
  CWF_RC_F_REVENUE.TOTAL_REVENUE_AMT AS Rev_Total_Amount,
  CWF_RC_F_REVENUE.REVENUE_QTY AS Rev_Quantity,
  RC_D_BILL_ITEM.CDM_TXT AS Rev_CDM_Code,
  RC_D_BILL_ITEM.CPT4_TXT AS Rev_CPT4_Code,
  RC_D_BILL_ITEM.REV_CODE_TXT AS Rev_Revenue_Code,
  RC_D_GL_ALIAS_DR.GL_ACCT_NBR_TXT AS Rev_Debit_GL_Number,
  RC_D_GL_ALIAS_CR.GL_ACCT_NBR_TXT AS Rev_Credit_GL_Number
FROM V500.RC_F_REVENUE CWF_RC_F_REVENUE,
     V500.RC_D_BILL_ITEM RC_D_BILL_ITEM,
     V500.RC_D_GL_ALIAS RC_D_GL_ALIAS_DR,
     V500.RC_D_GL_ALIAS RC_D_GL_ALIAS_CR,
     V500.PFT_CHARGE CWC_FINANCIAL_CHARGE,
     V500.CHARGE CWC_CHARGE,
     V500.PFT_ENCNTR CWC_FINANCIAL_ENCOUNTER,
     V500.ENCOUNTER CWC_ENCOUNTER,
     V500.PERSON CWC_PERSON
WHERE CWF_RC_F_REVENUE.RC_D_BILL_ITEM_ID = RC_D_BILL_ITEM.RC_D_BILL_ITEM_ID

  AND CWF_RC_F_REVENUE.PFT_CHARGE_ID = CWC_FINANCIAL_CHARGE.PFT_CHARGE_ID
  AND CWC_FINANCIAL_CHARGE.CHARGE_ITEM_ID = CWC_CHARGE.CHARGE_ITEM_ID
  AND CWF_RC_F_REVENUE.PFT_ENCNTR_ID = CWC_FINANCIAL_ENCOUNTER.PFT_ENCNTR_ID
  AND CWC_FINANCIAL_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID = CWC_ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_ID
  AND CWC_ENCOUNTER.PERSON_ID = CWC_PERSON.PERSON_ID
  AND CWF_RC_F_REVENUE.ACTIVE_IND = 1

birt_442_advanced_report_designer_catalo.slot_ordering_rule: Inside <report xmlns="http://www.eclipse.org/birt/2005/design" version="3.2.23" id="1">, child slots MUST appear in schema order: <property>/<text-property>/<list-property name="userProperties"> -> <parameters> -> <data-sources> -> <data-sets> -> <styles> -> <page-setup> -> <body>.

capabilities.title: Dataset-Level <list-property name="computedColumns"> and Table Bound Calculated/Aggregated Columns
capabilities.description: Defines derived Rhino JavaScript columns on <oda-data-set> via <list-property name="computedColumns"> (synced to columnHints and cachedMetaData/resultSet, but excluded from native ODA resultSet) and table/group-level aggregations in boundDataColumns.
capabilities.xml_snippet:
<list-property name="computedColumns">
    <structure>
        <property name="name">calc_los_days</property>
        <expression name="expression" type="javascript">BirtDateTime.diffDay(row["Enc Registration Dt/Tm"], row["Enc Discharge Dt/Tm"] != null ? row["Enc Discharge Dt/Tm"] : BirtDateTime.today())</expression>
        <property name="dataType">integer</property>
    </structure>
    <structure>
        <property name="name">calc_completed_cssrs_count</property>
        <expression name="expression" type="javascript">(row["CE Result Value"] ? 1 : 0) + (row["WishD:CE Result Value"] ? 1 : 0) + (row["LevelRisk:CE Result Value"] ? 1 : 0) + (row["SBehavior:CE Result Value"] ? 1 : 0) + (row["SMethod:CE Result Value"] ? 1 : 0) + (row["SPlan:CE Result Value"] ? 1 : 0) + (row["SIntent:CE Result Value"] ? 1 : 0)</expression>
        <property name="dataType">integer</property>
    </structure>
</list-property>
capabilities.guardrail: Every dataset computedColumn MUST be added to <list-property name="columnHints"> and <structure name="cachedMetaData"><list-property name="resultSet">, but NEVER to the bottom native ODA <list-property name="resultSet"> (which maps 1-to-1 by UUID to the JDBC/ODA result set).

capabilities.title: Group-Scoped and Table-Scoped Aggregate Bound Columns (COUNTDISTINCT, SUM, AVE, MAX, MIN, PERCENT-SUM)

</structure>
<structure>
    <property name="name">agg_unit_high_risk_count</property>

    <property name="dataType">integer</property>

capabilities.guardrail: In BIRT 3.2.23, aggregate boundDataColumns do NOT use <expression name="expression"> directly; they declare <property name="aggregateFunction">, pass the target expression inside <list-property name="arguments"><structure><property name="name">Expression</property><expression name="value" type="javascript">...</expression></structure></list-property>, and optionally scope to a group via <property name="aggregateOn">.

capabilities.guardrail: Place <parameters> before <data-sources> in <report>, use <simple-property-list name="defaultValue"><value type="constant">...</value></simple-property-list>, and always set isRequired="false" with an "ALL" default so unattended/scheduled executions never hang waiting for parameter input.

capabilities.title: Dataset, Table, and Group <list-property name="filter"> Conditions (is-true, eq, in, between, top-n, match)
capabilities.description: Applies post-fetch BIRT filter conditions on <oda-data-set>, <table>, or <group> to filter on computed columns, inline-joined subquery results, regex patterns, Top-N rankings, or report parameters (params["..."]).
capabilities.xml_snippet:
<list-property name="filter">
    <structure>
        <property name="operator">is-true</property>
        <expression name="expr" type="javascript">(params["p_NurseUnit"].value == null || params["p_NurseUnit"].value == "" || params["p_NurseUnit"].value == "ALL" || row["Enc Loc Nurse Unit"] == params["p_NurseUnit"].value) && (params["p_RiskFilter"].value == null || params["p_RiskFilter"].value == "ALL" || (params["p_RiskFilter"].value == "HIGH" && /high risk/i.test((row["LevelRisk:CE Result Value"] || "") + "")) || (params["p_RiskFilter"].value == "POSITIVE_ONLY" && /high risk|moderate risk|^yes$/i.test((row["CSSRS Risk and Endorsement Flag"] || "") + "")))</expression>
        <property name="updateAggregation">true</property>
    </structure>
</list-property>
capabilities.guardrail: In BIRT <list-property name="filter">, escape "&&" as "&&" in XML, set <property name="updateAggregation">true</property> so table/group subtotals recalculate after filtering, and use operator="is-true" for compound JavaScript boolean expressions or operator="eq|in|between|top-n" with <simple-property-list name="value1">.

capabilities.title: Multi-Key and Custom Calculated Clinical Ordinal <list-property name="sort"> Keys
capabilities.description: Sorts <table> or <group> rows by calculated JavaScript clinical severity rank (e.g., High risk -> 1, Moderate risk -> 2, Low risk -> 3, Other -> 4), followed by chronological timestamp descending and patient name ascending.
capabilities.xml_snippet:
<list-property name="sort">
    <structure>
        <expression name="key" type="javascript">var r = (row["LevelRisk:CE Result Value"] || row["CSSRS Risk and Endorsement Flag"] || "") + ""; /high risk/i.test(r) ? 1 : (/moderate risk/i.test(r) ? 2 : (/positive endorsement|^yes$/i.test(r) ? 3 : (/low risk/i.test(r) ? 4 : 5)))</expression>
        <property name="direction">asc</property>
        <property name="strength">-1</property>
    </structure>
    <structure>
        <expression name="key" type="javascript">row["CE End Dt/Tm"]</expression>
        <property name="direction">desc</property>
        <property name="strength">-1</property>
    </structure>
    <structure>
        <expression name="key" type="javascript">row["Person Name Full Format"]</expression>
        <property name="direction">asc</property>
        <property name="strength">-1</property>
    </structure>
</list-property>
capabilities.guardrail: Never rely on alphabetical sorting for clinical risk tiers (where "High", "Low", "Moderate" sorts "Low" before "Moderate"). Use a JavaScript ternary expression in <expression name="key" type="javascript"> returning integer ordinals (1, 2, 3...) with direction="asc".

capabilities.title: Conditional <list-property name="highlightRules"> and Format-Specific <list-property name="visibility">
capabilities.description: Applies visual clinical alerting (<list-property name="highlightRules">) on detail rows or cells (e.g., red #FEE2E2 background with bold #991B1B text for High Suicide Risk or positive endorsement; amber #FEF3C7 for Moderate Risk).
capabilities.xml_snippet:
<list-property name="highlightRules">

capabilities.guardrail: Place <joint-data-set> inside <data-sets> AFTER all referenced <oda-data-set> definitions; join on surrogate keys (dataSetRow['Enc Id'] or dataSetRow['Order Id']) to avoid 1-to-many Cartesian fan-out.
